messages:
marta-g: alert: routing fallback error spike flagged by perf-alerts. 5 enterprise clusters seeing >40% fallback rate and repeated model-mismatch errors. dashboards: https://redwood/dashboards/fallbacks :grimacing:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0315-47 - routing fallback loop. Pager duty escalated to oncall (samir-k). See /incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0315-47
samir-k: on it. grabbing logs + checking deploys. anyone touching routing-config schema in last 6 hours?
jules: i merged the schema migration earlier today that removed deprecated `fallback_order` and replaced with `route_priorities`. validated unit tests passed. nothing else.
leo-m: we started seeing drift in the migration job around 09:12 UTC — it rewrote some org configs to new schema but left legacy values blank for orgs using old defaults.
marta-g: initial customer impact: some dedicated customers in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 saw repeated 503s and model variant mismatches (requests getting routed to tiny-quant variant causing generation failures).
ivy-w: paging in. @samir-k handoff in 10 if you need. prepping rollback plan.
samir-k: logs show routing decision engine returning empty fallback list for ~12% of requests, engine then falls back to region-based round-robin which triggered cascade to incompatible model variants. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T09:18:22Z ROUTER INFO org=acme request_id=abc123 route_config_id=rc-998 fallback_list=[] selected_region=us-west-2 selected_variant=tiny-quant result=error model_token_err
2026-03-15T09:18:23Z ROUTER WARN route_config_rc-998 policy_version=v2.0.0 fallback_default=ANY_REGION
```

samir-k: hypothesis: schema migration left `fallback_list`unset for configs that relied on the deprecated `fallback_order` behavior. runtime default now treats empty list as permissive ANY_REGION fallback -> bad variants picked.
jules: confirmed — old behavior: missing fallback meant inherit `primary_region` only. new behavior: missing list == global ANY_REGION. migration script should have backfilled default, but it skipped orgs with custom flags.
ivy-w: mitigation options: 1) hotfix router to treat empty fallback_list as legacy-inherit-primary-region for 1 hour; 2) rollback schema migration; 3) bulk patch org configs to set explicit fallback_list.
leo-m: we can push (1) quickly — single-line default change in routing service. reduces risk of further wrong-variant selection.
samir-k: do (1) now. jules pls open rollback PR for migration simultaneously. i'll deploy config to router with feature-flag `legacy_fallback_compat=true`.
jules: opening PR: https://git/repo/pull/7423 - rollback migration + add idempotent backfill job.
pagerduty-bot: Paging NOTE: on-call transfer recorded. Previous acknowledger: samir-k. New ack: ivy-w.
ivy-w: rolling out hotfix to edge routers in canary (10%) -> watch metrics.
(2 minutes later)
ivy-w: canary looks good. fallback rate down from 42% -> 3% in canary. metrics: https://redwood/metrics/fallbacks/INCIDENT-2026-0315-47
samir-k: promote hotfix to 50% then 100%.
(10 minutes later)
ivy-w: hotfix at 100%. fallbacks normalized. model-variant mismatch errors dropped to near-zero. pushing config to backfill job now (low-risk).
jules: backfill job started: will write explicit `fallback_list` for 4.2k orgs that had blank values. job is idempotent and logged.
marta-g: customer impact summary for CS: ~6 enterprise customers reported degraded calls (503s) between 09:15-09:40 UTC. error rates peaked at +15% for affected customers. estimated tokens lost ~1.2M. will coordinate postmortem notice. @cs-notify-bot pls prepare embargoed note.
cs-notify-bot: Draft created: "Incident affecting routing fallbacks — temporary degraded availability for select enterprise customers. ETA for full report: 72 hours."
leo-m: long term fixes: add schema migration step that writes explicit default fallback_list for deprecated configs; add a validation gate in config service to reject config with empty fallback_list unless explicitly opting-in to ANY_REGION; add unit + integration tests simulating old->new migrations.
samir-k: root cause summary for incident notes: schema migration removed implicit legacy default behavior without backfilling org configs; runtime default semantics changed (empty -> ANY_REGION) causing cross-region fallback loops and incompatible variant selection.
ivy-w: action items assigned:
- jules: rollback PR + backfill job (PR opened) [in progress]
- jules & leo-m: add migration test and pre-migration dry-run tool (todo)
- samir-k: add runtime flag to interpret empty fallback_list as legacy for next 30 days + telemetry (done/pushed)
- marta-g: customer comms + impact timeline (drafted)
- ops: run sweep for any orgs where `fallback_list`==[] and `policy_version`>=v2.0.0 (in progress)
- eng-sre: add alert tuning to differentiate fallback rate vs normal retry noise (todo)

jules: will keep this thread updated with PR links and job progress.
(30 minutes later)
jules: backfill job finished. wrote explicit fallback_list for 4,208 orgs. sample patched config:
```
{
  "org": "acme",
  "route_config_id": "rc-998",
  "primary_region": "eu-west-1",
  "fallback_list": ["eu-west-1"],
  "policy_version": "v2.0.0"
}
```

ivy-w: confirm: all affected customers show recovery and no further paging. any customer still seeing issues escalate to support.
cs-notify-bot: Notifying affected customers with embargoed note now.
marta-g: incident severity: Sev2. customer impact limited to select enterprise clusters; no data exfiltration or model correctness regressions beyond variant mismatch.
samir-k: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, mitigations, and code pointers. assign owners, due EOD+72h.
leo-m: propose adding a schema compatibility test to CI that runs migrations against a snapshot of production configs monthly.
jules: agreed. adding to roadmap.
(Next day)
ivy-w: handover: I'm closing active mitigation. logging final notes in incident tracker.
incident-bot: INCIDENT-2026-0315-47 status: resolved -> monitoring. severity: Sev2. lead: samir-k. followups: 6 action items assigned.
